module: Lua backend of the big map in the Vue UI: prepares for the UI the list of points of interest (POIs: missions, garages, stations, dealerships, dragstrips, spawn points, the player's vehicle...), the filters and groups of the side list, the game state, and relays the UI's actions (selection, hover, navigation, panning, execution of POI actions) to freeroam_bigMapMode. The data is cached on opening (enterBigMap) and freed on closing (exitBigMap). UI-side calls go through bngApi.engineLua (see the file's header comment); Lua -> Vue goes through guihooks.trigger('showPoiDetails', {poiIds, ignoreReduction}). Depends on gameplay_missions_missions, freeroam_bigMapMode, gameplay_rawPois, gameplay_missions_missionScreen. Global: freeroam_vueBigMap.
notes: Filter structure: sections {key, icon, label, groups = {{key, label, icon, elementCount, visible}}}. The groups (getGroups) only contain visible, non-empty groups, with elementIds (POI ids) and a translated label.

Icons by POI type: spawnPoint=fastTravel, garage=garage01, gasStation=fuelPump, dealership=carDealer, logisticsParking/logisticsOffice=boxTruckFast, computer=screen, driftSpot=drift01, dragstrip=drag02, crawl=rockCrawling02, playerVehicle=carStarred, other=info.

POI actions are registered with addAction(callback, meta) (returns meta.actionId) and run by executeAction(actionId) / executePoiAction; clearActionFunctions empties them on leaving the map (exitBigMap).
setPoiListDisplayMode accepts 'hidden', 'tree' or 'simple' (poiListDisplayMode setting), otherwise returns 'invalid_mode'.
selectPoiFromList/navigateToPoi/panToPoi treat the strings "undefined" and "null" (sent by the UI) as nil.
In onPoiSelectedFromBigmap, ignoreNextReductionFlag is set back to false before being passed in `ignoreReduction` of the showPoiDetails hook, which therefore always receives false.
The gameStateInfoCache.gameMode field is 'mission' when a mission is in the foreground (gameplay_missions_missionManager.getForegroundMissionId()).

enterBigMap.desc: Opens the big map: delegates to freeroam_bigMapMode.enterBigMap (instant), generates the POI/filter/group caches and applies the POIs' visibility.

options.desc: {controllerUsed?: boolean, isMenuBigmap?: boolean, ignoreUiStateChange?: boolean}; ignoreUiStateChange defaults to isMenuBigmap; the action maps are ignored if controllerUsed and isMenuBigmap.

exitBigMap.desc: Closes the big map (freeroam_bigMapMode.exitBigMap(true)), empties the caches and the actions.

getPoiData.desc: Full POI data by id (name, preview, aggregates, available actions), generated if the cache is invalid.

getFilters.desc: Filter sections, each group with its current `visible` state.

getGroups.desc: Groups for the POI list: visible, non-empty sections and groups.

returns.desc: Sections {key, icon, title, groups[{key, label, icon, elementIds, visible, openByDefault}]}.

toggleFiltersByIds.desc: Makes visible only the groups whose keys are given (all the others are hidden) and updates the visibility on the map.

toggleFilterSectionById.desc: Shows all groups (sectionId 'everything') or only those of the given section.

getGameStateInfo.desc: Game state information for the POI list, with poiListDisplayMode (setting, 'tree' by default).

setVisibleIds.desc: Computes the POI ids of the visible groups and calls freeroam_bigMapMode.setOnlyIdsVisible.

selectPoiFromList.desc: Selects a POI from the list (freeroam_bigMapMode.selectPoi) or deselects if the id is null.

isCollapsedMode.desc: If false, the next group reduction is ignored.

getAndClearPendingAutoSelectPoiId.desc: Retrieves then clears the POI id to auto-select requested when the map opened, from freeroam_bigMapMode.

navigateToPoi.desc: Computes a route to the POI (freeroam_bigMapMode.navigateToMission).

panToPoi.desc: Centers the map view on the POI.

onPoiSelectedFromBigmap.desc: Called by the map when a POI is selected on it: sends showPoiDetails to the UI with the POI ids grouped under the mouse (freeroam_bigMapMarkers.getIdsFromHoveredPoiId) or an empty list.

hoverPoiFromList.desc: Highlights the marker of the POI hovered in the list.

executePoiAction.desc: Runs a registered POI action (see executeAction).

setPoiListDisplayMode.desc: Sets the list display mode ('hidden', 'tree', 'simple') in the settings.

getFreeActionId.desc: Increments and returns a new action identifier.

addAction.desc: Registers an action callback and returns the meta table enriched with actionId.

executeAction.desc: Runs an action's callback; error log if unknown.
